title: Figram: user snapshot, version 1 (engine protocol 3)
description: What the host stores between events. Strict: unknown fields are forbidden. Integer fields (`seq`, tokens) are exact integers; a validator that stores numbers as doubles (jsonschema, ajv) may also accept `1e-400` or `9007199254740990.5`; the strict decoder of the engine decides (docs/format.md, section 3, "Numbers").

back.description: The place to go back to: the message the user left when they last crossed a section boundary.

timers.description: Active timers: name → token of the run.

pending.description: Waits for outcomes, the newest first: the action and the token of the step that performed it (docs/format.md, section 7, decision 12). An entry of an action that is no longer in the document is kept.

token.description: The token of the call: the outcome event carries it.

seq.description: The number of the last transition.
